# Holston Medical Group

> Holston Medical Group provides comprehensive primary care, urgent care, and specialty medical services across Tennessee and Virginia with integrated patient portal and digital health tools.

Holston Medical Group (HMG) operates multiple clinics including Seasons for Women and Bristol Pediatric Associates across the Tennessee-Virginia region. The organization emphasizes patient access through digital tools like FollowMyHealth portal and maintains HIPAA compliance standards.

## Key Topics

- FollowMyHealth
- Patient Portal
- Primary Care
- Medical Records
- Appointment Requests
- Medication Refills
- HIPAA Compliance

- Kingsport

- 21st Century Cures Act

## Patient Portal & Access

- [FollowMyHealth - Patient Portal for Refills, Appointments & More](https://www.holstonmedicalgroup.com/followmyhealth): Patient portal for secure appointment requests, medication refills, and health records
- [Medical Records Release - How to get your medical records at HMG](https://www.holstonmedicalgroup.com/medical-records-release): Instructions for accessing and requesting medical records from HMG
- [Patient Forms - Holston Medical Group](https://www.holstonmedicalgroup.com/patient-forms): Downloadable patient intake forms for new patients and specialty care

## Find Care & Locations

- [Find a Doctor | Holston Medical Group](https://www.holstonmedicalgroup.com/find-a-doctor): Search and find HMG providers by name, specialty, and location
- [HMG Locations - Holston Medical Group](https://www.holstonmedicalgroup.com/locations): Directory of HMG clinic locations across Tennessee and Virginia
- [Specialties | Holston Medical Group](https://www.holstonmedicalgroup.com/specialties): Overview of medical specialties and clinical departments offered by HMG

## Billing & Support

- [Billing Information - Holston Medical Group](https://www.holstonmedicalgroup.com/billing): Billing assistance, payment methods, and contact information for HMG
